scope.changes: Five source dispatch adapters, one borrowed context, documentation and evidence. Existing R35/R33 providers and their guards remain unchanged.
scope.unchanged: Application, GameStartupHost, frame, sound, input, XLive, renderer callbacks, shared deletion layout, clock lifecycle and raw methods.
scope.ownership: No clock allocation, registration, ownership, process binding, synthetic vtable or independently advancing state. std::logic_error is a source failure mechanism and may use the C++ runtime; this is not an allocation-free failure ABI claim.

public_context.lifetime: Borrow the SAME persistent publication cell and method context. Published pointer must designate live, accessible, genuine80h storage; profile table must remain readable through every operation. No storage-size or dangling-pointer validation is claimed.
public_context.capture: Each operation loads current AB0 exactly once into a local pointer. Calls made later independently reload the cell. No universal cached owner.
public_context.identity: Require non-null clock and methods.profile_d68d50; read object profile DWORD and require D68D50; read the selected borrowed slot word and require its exact original target. Never execute that numeric target.
public_context.failure: Null publication/profile, unsupported object profile or target, and null sample output raise std::logic_error at the source boundary. No native fault/FH3/SEH ABI equivalence. Existing R35/R33 failure behavior inside their providers is unchanged.

operations.native_abi: ECX=actual clock, RET; existing raw provider preserves recovered stack/x87 schedule.
operations.result: One invocation on captured current owner; no separate sample or success-BOOL branch.
Borrow actual16B current member. No ClockTimestamp or FrameClock cast/copy inside the helper.
Borrow actual16B interval member. The caller controls result lifetime and any timestamp value copy.

operations.native_abi: Original ECX=clock, stack destination, EAX=destination, RET4. Existing source bridge adds unused EDX.
operations.result: Forward caller output pointer unchanged before raw sampler; fixed branch copies current, real branch samples QPC. No output initialization, QPC BOOL branch or duplicate sampler.

operations.native_abi: Original ECX=clock, signed int32 milliseconds on stack, RET4. Existing source bridge adds unused EDX.
operations.result: Forward signed milliseconds unchanged; no conversion to seconds or unsigned value.
